hero.title: Your health, in your hands
hero.lineNoIndex: Your Index starts with your first step. Let's set your baseline together.
hero.lineUp: You're moving up. What you've done these past days is working. Keep going!
hero.lineDown: A small dip is part of the journey. One step today turns the curve around.
hero.lineSteady: Your foundation is set. From here, every step you take shows up in this number.

steps.title: Let's improve your health
steps.subtitle: Your next steps, in the order that moves you forward the most.
steps.allDone: All the essentials are done. Now every day counts — keep it up!
steps.bloodBody: Your blood tells us what no tracker can. Upload your latest blood panel — Vitana reads it and tunes your plan to it.
steps.bloodNoTest: No recent blood test? Here's how to get a lab test
steps.devicesBody: Let Apple Health, Samsung Health, your watch or your ring track sleep, steps and heart rate for you — automatically.
steps.focusBody: This is your biggest lever right now. Small steps here move your Index up the fastest.
steps.focusBodyEven: Your pillars are level right now. Start here — small, regular steps move your Index up the fastest.
steps.journeyBody: Every action you complete on your journey adds points — and staying consistent earns the streak bonus.

goal.title: Your 90-day goal
goal.noIndex: As soon as your baseline is set, we'll show you here how far your goal is.
goal.toThriving: You're {points} points away from the thriving zone. You can do this — one step at a time.
goal.toElite: You're in the thriving zone! {points} more points to elite.
goal.elite: You're elite. Keep the balance and your streaks — you're setting the example.
goal.thrivingExplain: The thriving zone — within reach in 90 focused days.
goal.eliteExplain: Elite — sustained excellence across all five pillars, over months.
goal.compass: We never push you to the top. Every life has different capacities — the number is a compass, not a verdict.

pillars.title: Your five pillars
pillars.subtitle: Each pillar adds up to 200 points. Your weakest one is your biggest lever.

balance.even: Your pillars are well balanced — every point counts in full.
balance.slight: One pillar is lagging a little. Lift it so your Index counts in full.
balance.uneven: Your pillars are uneven, and that holds your Index back. Start with your biggest lever.
balance.veryUneven: One pillar is far behind and holds your Index back noticeably. That's where every step pays off most.

how.title: How your Index grows
how.subtitle: Five ingredients — and every one of them is in your hands.
how.baselineBody: Comes from your onboarding survey — your starting point.
how.actionsBody: Every action from your journey in the last 30 days counts toward its pillar.
how.dataBody: Trackers, blood results and your own logs show what's really happening.
how.streakBody: Consistency is rewarded — day after day.
how.balanceBody: When one pillar is far behind the others, it dampens the total. Balanced counts for more.
